note: Canonical single source of truth for Baltor native-format-preservation OUTPUT MODES (C-NATIVE-1). The output_mode config selects how Baltor projects governed context back to a customer. The ORIGINAL is NEVER overwritten in any mode (lossless-distillation law). 'mutates_values' means the SAME-SHAPE projection may carry a VERIFIED value change (recorded as a NativeDiff with a receipt) vs. the source value — it NEVER means the source bytes are altered. 'byte_identical' is true only for native_passthrough (and the native_output of native_passthrough_with_sidecar). 'emits_sidecar' means a SidecarOverlay (governance power: receipts/conflicts/held_out/lineage) is produced alongside. Read with scripts/check_native_output_modes.py; do not re-define these elsewhere. Spec: prompts/baltor-native-format-preservation.md; _repos/baltor/context/native/output-modes.md.
law: lossless-distillation: the original is never overwritten; held-out is never erased; every value change carries a NativeDiff + receipt; everything rehydrates to source bytes/hash + artifacts.

fields.id: the output_mode value passed in the export config
fields.mutates_values: true iff the same-shape projection MAY replace a source value with a VERIFIED value (NativeDiff + receipt); never mutates source bytes
fields.emits_sidecar: true iff a SidecarOverlay governance sidecar is produced alongside the native output
fields.byte_identical: true iff the native_output is byte-for-byte the source bytes

output_modes.description: The original is returned unchanged. Pure compatibility / drop-in; Baltor adds no surface and changes no value.
best_for: legal/audit holds where no derived value may be returned

output_modes.description: The original is returned unchanged AND a *.baltor.sidecar.json governance overlay (receipts, conflicts, held-out claims, lineage, warnings) is produced alongside. Safest power mode: zero value change to the customer's payload.
best_for: adding governance without touching the payload

output_modes.description: Same schema/keys/columns/order; a value MAY change ONLY when VERIFIED (e.g. "30 days" -> "10 business days"), and every change is recorded as a NativeDiff entry with a receipt. Drop-in shape with corrected facts.
best_for: drop-in replacement that must carry corrected facts
downstream systems keyed on exact schema/columns

output_modes.description: Same schema/keys/columns/order with VERIFIED value changes (each a NativeDiff + receipt) PLUS a SidecarOverlay carrying the receipts, conflicts, held-out claims, reconciliations, and warnings.
best_for: regulated drop-in: corrected values in-shape AND a defensible audit trail
field-level provenance alongside a same-shape payload

output_modes.description: Same document format (Markdown/HTML/DOCX) with annotations/comments/footnotes/frontmatter added; the underlying answer-critical content is preserved, governance is surfaced inline. No source value is silently replaced.
best_for: docs/knowledge-base where editors want inline warnings + receipts
Markdown/Obsidian notes that should stay readable

output_modes.description: The advanced Baltor surface: a ContextResponse / ContextPack with served_facts, held_out_warnings, conflicts, reconciliations, and full receipt lineage. Maximum governance power; not the customer's native shape.
best_for: agents/consumers that adopt Baltor's governed contract directly

output_modes.description: Both the same-shape native output AND the baltor_native ContextResponse are returned, so a customer can migrate from native compatibility toward the governed surface without changing systems twice.
best_for: A-side native + B-side governed in one call

output_modes.description: Original + updated same-shape projection + a NativeDiff (changed_fields with old/new/decision/receipt_id) + the SidecarOverlay. The diff makes every VERIFIED value change reviewable before adoption.
best_for: human review of proposed corrections before drop-in
